parole.significato: A stew of beef or veal and vegetables, flavoured with paprika.
parole.testo: From French goulasch, itself from Hungarian gulyás (“herdsman”), an ellipsis of gulyáshús (“herdsman meat”), gulyásétel (“herdsman food”), and/or gulyástokány (“herdsman stew”). First attested in English 1866.

parole.significato: A stiff, cylindrical military dress hat with a metal plate in front, a short visor, and a plume.
parole.testo: Borrowed from French shako, from Hungarian csákó (“cylindrical military dress hat worn by the Hungarian hussars from the 18th century to World War I”).

parole.significato: A narrow braid often decorated with a herringbone pattern
parole.testo: Borrowed from French soutache, from Hungarian sujtás (“ribbon, braid”).
